# MXPACKPRO

MXPACKPRO is the international website of Foshan Xumelo Technology Co., Ltd., a custom food packaging supplier based in Foshan, China.

## Core pages
- https://mxpackpro.com/products.html — food packaging product categories
- https://mxpackpro.com/custom-packaging.html — custom structure, printing and sampling process
- https://mxpackpro.com/solutions.html — packaging by food business type
- https://mxpackpro.com/resources.html — packaging buying guides
- https://mxpackpro.com/about-us.html — company and project support
- https://mxpackpro.com/faq.html — MOQ, artwork, materials, samples and production answers
- https://mxpackpro.com/get-a-quote.html — contact and quotation request
